title: PokoTycoon Client Pack
changelog: PokoRogue Client 0.11.1 내장 업데이트. 업적 1.1.2 수정 및 기존 WebGUI·리그·다른 모드·리소스 유지. 서버 파일 변경 없음.
클라이언트 1.1.2: 업적 대용량 데이터를 분할 수신해 무한 로딩을 해결합니다(서버 PixelAchievements 0.1.46 필요). 누락 시 재연결과 기존 창 복구를 지원합니다.
클라이언트 1.1.1: 리그 화면 추가(대응 서버 필요), 업적 로딩 제한·재연결·닫기 보완, 독립 WebGUI 클릭음 추가, 포코로그 보라색 배경 유지 및 바깥 여백 투명화. 기존 모드·리소스 유지.
클라이언트 1.1.0: 배틀 이어하기 0.1.1, Poko Battle Skin 0.2.1, PokoRogue 클라이언트 0.11.0 내장. 우편함·시장 버튼, 포코로그 허브, 전설 도감·등록 화면, 칭호 아이콘 14개 추가. 리소스팩에 황금 낚싯대·가을 소풍 치장 추가. 기존 모드·WebGUI·리소스 유지.
100 칭호 전용 아이콘 추가. 기존 위키 진화조건 수정·모든 모드·리소스 유지.

Correct wiki evolution-condition descriptions including Meltan iron feeding, Gimmighoul coins, party, nature, battle and scroll requirements. Only wiki/pokemon.js changed; all existing modules, UI fixes and resources preserved.

Keep the megaphone slot visible while chat is open; wiki Back returns to the main menu instead of the shop. Preserve all 1.0.16 features and resource packs. Auction keep-open behavior requires the separately staged server plugin.
Auction enchantment names/levels and enchanted book name correction. Validate enchantment arrays and retain all 1.0.15 features. Detailed enchantments require PokoAuction 1.0.38 server data.
Show village contribution share in personal rankings when supplied by the server. Preserve ranking images/fonts, wiki fixes and all existing modules; correct duplicate community asset path.
Fix island/personal ranking images and fonts; improve loading, empty and unavailable states. Correct duplicate community asset path. Preserve all 1.0.13 modules and wiki behavior.
Restore original large-screen wiki home layout; apply responsive fix only at width <=1250px or height <=700px. Preserve direct close and all other modules.
Fix wiki home windowed layout and close directly to game instead of opening shop; preserve all other modules and resources.
Fix wiki JavaScript module extension and bounded auction icon retries; preserve personal ranking, party/bulk contribution, champion road, Ditto Guard and every other existing module.
섬 개인 랭킹·보상 탭 추가. 기존 파티 표시·전체 공헌 제출, 위키·업적·경매장·챔피언 로드·메타몽 보호·리소스를 모두 보존. 개인 보상은 섬 서버 전용 플러그인 적용 후 이용.
경매장·업적·위키 화면과 별도 PokoChatUI 추가. 기존 챔피언 로드·섬·레이팅·메타몽 보호 및 모든 리소스를 보존하고 업적 칭호 아이콘 5종 추가. 새 연동 화면은 대응 서버 구성 적용 후 사용.
100만 누적 칭호 아이콘 추가. 기존 리소스 및 통합 모드 유지.
송편 모자 노랑·초록·핑크 3종 추가. 기존 리소스 및 Ditto Client Guard 통합 모드 유지.
PokoDittoClientGuard 0.2.0 추가: 클라이언트 변신·전투 표시에서 누락된 폼/팔레트의 기본값 처리. 기존 모드·WebGUI·리소스팩 유지.
체육관 화면의 챔피언 로드 궁전 이미지와 글자를 70px 위로 이동. 크기·내부 화면·기존 기능·리소스팩 유지.
체육관에 챔피언 로드·사천왕/챔피언 선택 추가. 섬 전체 공헌, 레이팅·배틀타워 수정, BattleInfo rc4 및 리소스팩 유지.
섬 공헌 파티 번호·파티 전용 납품·선택 품목 전체 납품 UI 반영. BattleInfo rc4와 기존 모드·리소스팩 유지. 전체 납품은 대응 서버 플러그인 적용 후 활성화.
섬 포켓몬 납품 현황·상태 필터·자동 갱신 UI 추가. BattleInfo rc4 및 다른 내장 모드·리소스팩 유지. 새 서버 기능은 대응 플러그인 적용 후 사용.
마이닝 리소스 모델 3개(shard/gravel/golem)의 꼬마돌·데구리·딱구리 아이콘 참조 수정. 나머지 리소스 및 BattleInfo rc4 통합 모드 유지.
BattleInfo rc4: 교체·가방·대상 선택창 추가 패널 겹침 방지. 서버 rc3 프로토콜 호환, 기존 WebGUI·모드·리소스 유지.
PokoBattleInfo 0.1.0-rc3 통합: 기술 상성·타입 표시, 서버 능력치 단계 동기화. 기존 WebGUI·내장 모드·리소스팩 유지.
볼 칭호 아이콘 8종 및 추석 치장 추가팩 통합. 광부·기존 리소스 유지, 달토끼 짚신과 꽃신 텍스처 칸 분리. 볼 아이콘은 poko_balls:icons 폰트 사용.
PokoMining 1.2.1 광부 도구 리소스 통합. 기존 스타터 도구·달토끼 망치 CMD 매핑과 모든 기존 리소스를 보존하고 광부 도구 매핑만 추가.
섬 커뮤니티 community-repair 화면 및 기여 항목 아이콘 1,007개 반영. 배틀타워 즉시 입장, 기존 통신 코드·다른 내장 모드·리소스팩 유지.
섬 커뮤니티 community-finish 화면 반영 및 배틀타워 입장 /배틀타워 즉시 명령 전송. 중복 전송 방지와 구매 검증, 다른 내장 모드 및 기존 리소스팩 유지.
섬 커뮤니티·랭킹 UI 및 입력 단축키 업데이트, 배틀타워 화면 선표시, 챔피언 PB 아이콘 등록 및 전용 폰트 아이콘 3종 추가. 기존 레이팅 연결 수정과 리소스 유지.

Fixed rating and random battle response event names; bounded rating hello retries handle late game bridge initialization. Preserved session/sequence validation, manual-only match/purchase actions, existing modules, palettes and resources.

Fixed WebGUI rating lazy-module imports and refreshed UI script cache keys. Embedded the unchanged click sound to avoid custom-scheme media fetch dependence. Preserved champion palettes, other modules and the Moon Rabbit resource pack.
Added Moon Rabbit cosmetics with collision-safe CMD 876200-876207. Preserved Giratina, golden crops, existing armor tiles, HUD, BGM and all client modules.
Added Iron Bundle champion and champion_gold client palettes, textures and sprites. Existing WebGUI screens, island help, tower, other modules and resource pack are unchanged.
Island Help now runs /섬 도움말 and closes WebGUI. Only the exact command is allowed; every other module and the integrated resource pack are preserved.

Added Paldea rc4, Battle Tower and island community WebGUI, champion icons and golden crop resources. Existing modules, HUD, cosmetics and single-pack BGM are preserved; matching server components activate on the next maintenance restart.

Use the existing six BGM files in the single launcher resource pack. Add named sound events for server-controlled continuous playback; suppress automatic world music to avoid overlap. No second music pack download.

Updated only the bundled PokoChampionsMega from 0.3.7-rc1 to 0.4.0-rc1, including the 0.3.9 fixes and revised idle models for 34 Mega forms. All 36 code classes and 37 data entries match the installed server module 0.3.9-rc1. Other bundled modules and the adventure BGM resource pack are preserved.

Replaced Overworld, creative and underwater background music with six streamed adventure tracks while preserving all existing resources, sound effects, title/Nether/End/boss music and Pixelmon sound definitions.
Added bundled Poko Champions Mega 0.3.7-rc1 and the Mew /랜덤배틀 menu button; preserved all five existing bundled modules. Mega multiplayer verification and matching server rollout remain separate.
Integrated 48 cosmetics including nine boots and 70 head/face combinations while preserving existing HUD, fishing-rod and other resources.

Updated exactly ten Poko fishing-rod model files for Altaria, Chi-Yu, Fuecoco, Magby, and Rowlet in normal and cast states while preserving the unified BetterHud font resources and every unrelated asset.

Unified the BetterHud 전체 채팅, 대기중, timer, and numeric HUD text under the bundled TTTogether font by disabling the default bitmap merge; all existing resources and corrected fishing-rod mappings are preserved.
Applied the corrected fishing-rod custom-model-data mappings while preserving the currently deployed BetterHud common and wild HUD font mappings and status textures.
Added PokoCosmetics tool and fishing-rod models while preserving the managed pack filename, pack ID, metadata, and unrelated assets.

Updated PokotycoonResources.zip with BetterHud status images, conflict-safe Sea/Fire/Sky character fishing rods, refreshed Altaria and Magikarp assets, and the PokoCosmetics Chi-Yu hardware update while preserving existing Pixelmon rod mappings and all prior resources.

Updated PokotycoonClient to 1.0.9 with the client-only Poko Pixelmon Fix 0.4.2 boss-drop screen recovery while preserving Pokotykon Skin 0.4.11, the current WebGUI including /잠수 and /배틀타워, PokeGacha, and Pokotykon Transform.
Updated PokotycoonResources.zip with 38 new starter-tool and fishing-rod resources and 16 item-model updates while preserving every file from the previous resource pack.

Updated the bundled WebGUI with the latest local UI assets and changed the Battle Tower button to request the exact /배틀타워 command through matching client/server security allowlists; all other PokotycoonClient modules are preserved.

Updated PokotycoonResources.zip with the auction house home, category, history, expired, personal listing, purchase, recovery, sale, navigation-state, and page-number resources while preserving every existing resource.
Updated PokotycoonResources.zip to the resource pack currently selected in both local clients, including 16 starter-tool/item model refinements and 21 new polished starter-tool textures.

Updated the bundled Pokotykon Skin client module to 0.4.11 with safe form fallback slots, post-battle UGC palette restoration, a 10,000 DP-Cash palette price, and a 2,000 DP-Cash creator royalty while preserving protocol 11.
Updated PokotycoonResources.zip to the resource pack currently used by the Pokotycoon Minecraft client, including the latest Pixelmon and Pokotycoon resource additions.
Fixed the WebGUI 잠수 button so its exact /잠수 command passes the client security allowlist; all other bundled modules and assets are preserved.
Updated the bundled Pokotykon Skin client module to 0.4.10 with safe Pixelmon palette fallback, on-demand PNG delivery, SHA-256 cache reuse, and live texture refresh while preserving protocol 11.
Added the client-side 잠수 button to the Warp menu; it sends /잠수 through the existing WebGUI command bridge, with responsive placement for desktop and smaller windows.

Updated PokotycoonClient to 1.0.7 with the bundled island ranking WebGUI: 30-minute refresh, one-line descriptions, consistent recommendation labels, and recommendation/member/creation-date tie-breaking.
Updated the bundled WebGUI island upgrade guide to 50×50, 100×100, 200×200, and 300×300, and corrected the first upgrade price to 2,000,000 coins.
Updated PokotycoonClient 1.0.6 to register the Dohwa Alolan Ninetales sprite directly in the block texture atlas; the icon display was verified in game.
Updated PokotycoonClient 1.0.6 to register the Dohwa Ninetales sprite atlas anchor so PixelBook renders the custom icon as a flat sprite.
Updated PokotycoonClient to 1.0.6 with the client-side evolution wait correction and Dohwa event skin resources while preserving every other launcher asset.
Updated PokotycoonClient to 1.0.5 so Pixelmon chair mounts remain valid down to each dimension's minimum build height, including Overworld Y=-64.
Updated obsolete PokotycoonClient replacement mappings so every superseded client points to the required PokotycoonClient-1.0.5.jar.
Test transition to stock Pixelmon 9.3.16 with PokotycoonClient 1.0.4 client-side stability fixes and PokoMegaAbilityFix 0.4.0 on the server.
Updated Pixelmon 9.3.16 to the verified R16 post-level-up client ready handoff build while preserving its original launcher filename.
Updated Pixelmon 9.3.16 to the verified R15 trainer-battle experience synchronization and elapsed-time client battle wait build while preserving its original launcher filename.
Updated Pixelmon 9.3.16 to the verified R14 experience and battle-task guard build while preserving its original launcher filename.
Updated Pixelmon 9.3.16 to the verified R11 SwitchOutTask cleanup build while preserving its original launcher filename.
Updated PokotycoonClient to 1.0.3 with virtual HTTPS WebGUI backed by JAR-local resources.
Updated the Pixelmon 9.3.16 bug-fix build while preserving its original launcher filename.
Removed the Skin Palette purchase limit and hid monthly-count text when the allowance is unlimited.
Moved the 10% Dream Ability Scroll to the Gacha category at a price of 300,000 coins.
Renamed EV Tuner to 노력치 세팅기 and removed the Good Rod from the bundled PokoTycoon Webshop.
Preserved the Dream Ability Scroll, verified MCEF compatibility layer, and all existing client utilities.
Added the 300,000 coin Dream Ability Scroll card to the bundled PokoTycoon Webshop.
Preserved the verified MCEF compatibility layer and all existing client utilities.
ModernUI is not distributed by PokoTycoon; existing local copies are left untouched.
Updated the PokoTycoonClient bundled WebGUI and compatibility hooks.
Added PokoTycoonClient and its MCEF runtime dependency.
Moved five redistributable client utilities to the PokoTycoon release.
Downloads JourneyMap 6.0.0-beta.54 from the official Modrinth CDN.
Selected the verified Pixelmon 9.3.16 client file already used by the PokoTycoon macOS test installation.
Removes only exact verified superseded client files after their replacement is installed.
Disabled general unlisted-file deletion for this transition.
